plain: pulsar is free GPLv3; $490/yr (SKU pulsar-exception) to embed it in one closed product. AWARE is a hosted compressor — paid access, no source ($9/day · $49/mo · $490/yr). The zeros demo is free: all-zero data → 8 bytes on POST /api/specialist. Chamber, Rider, CuNi, and Lab Pass are products with prices. The production engine is private.
rule: Free demos and open-source stay public. Putting open code in a closed product needs a paid written exception. Hosted products are access: you run them, you do not get the encoder.
never_on_this_surface: gzip, brotli, xz, or bzip2 sold as ours
